column1: # Series folders for the nested main screen (collgen.py nested --series): the community example (#190).
# A private checkout keeps its own list in personal/skills/collections/series.tsv, which wins (nested.data_path).
# One row per franchise, tab separated:
# slug     folder name (a-z 0-9 -), also the key in folder_text.tsv (virtual 'series')
# name     Python regex, re.search on the DISPLAY name (the cleaned <name>); case-sensitive unless it starts with (?i)
# systems  comma list of ES-DE system dirs the game must be in, or - for any
# developer  regex that must match the whole <developer> text, or - for any (a game must pass name AND systems AND developer)
# min      show the folder only with at least this many games; - means the default (3).
# A game can match several series and still sits in its genre and decade folders. A bad regex or row stops the run (exit 3).
